review_text: If it were possible, I would give this place zero stars. We ordered two iced coffees — a Cafe Latte and a Fudge Latte and a box of munchskin which the staff claimed was their best seller. We are traveling and have a long drive ahead, so we were hoping for a good cup of coffee. Unfortunately, when we took a sip of the extra-large coffees, it tasted like pure sugar syrup — absolutely no coffee flavor at all. It was extremely sweet and completely undrinkable. Very disappointing experience. The male staff member who made the drinks just went back inside the office/quarters, and there was no effort to check if the drinks were okay. Total waste of money. I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for real coffee.
